verdict.rationale: CDP supports event-driven automation via webhooks (real-time notifications for wallet activity, deposits, etc.) and some built-in auto-actions like auto-credit/auto-liquidation on deposit arrival, which let developers react to events with custom logic. However, there is no evidence of a native rule-builder or conditional trigger-action engine (e.g., 'if X then Y') — automation must be hand-coded by consuming webhooks, not configured declaratively. Missing for 10: a first-party rules/automation engine or no-code trigger builder, richer event-condition-action mapping, and independent evidence of this being used for arbitrary custom triggers beyond payments-specific auto-credit/liquidation.
